inlines.v: LOUSE, noun lous. plural lice. A small insect of the genus Pediculus. It has six feet, two eyes, with long feelers and a sting in the mouth. It infests the bodies of men and other animals; but different animals are infested with different species. LOUSE, verb transitive louz. To clean from lice.
